schema: claims v1 (see CLAIM_SCHEMA.py); every entry is dX/dt under scope
note: This is the symbolic surface of modern_sims.py (Level 6). Unlike the
repo-level .claims file, these claims are NOT yet registered equations in
EquationRegistry — they are the mathematical frameworks the Level 6 sims
Each claim carries an 'anchor': the registry equation id it extends, and a
'morphism': the name of the transformation that would carry the anchor to
this framework. Promoting a claim means adding the target equation to
EquationRegistry._register_all() and the anchor->target edge to graph.py.
tests/test_modern_claims.py enforces that every anchor resolves against the
live registry and every 'sim' resolves against modern_sims.REGISTRY.

claims.claim: d(observable)/dt = Koopman_operator(observable): nonlinear flow on state space is linear flow on observable space; DMD recovers a finite-rank truncation with bounded reconstruction error
claims.scope: dissipative ODEs away from fixed-point degeneracy; demonstrated on Van der Pol, rank 6

claims.claim: d(rho)/dt = -grad_W2 Entropy(rho): the heat equation is steepest descent of entropy in the Wasserstein metric (JKO scheme)
claims.scope: 1D, entropic regularization eps>0, variance grows linearly in time

claims.claim: d(theta)/dt follows geodesics of the Fisher-Rao metric; the Gaussian statistical manifold is the Poincare half-plane
d(filtration)/d(epsilon) changes Betti numbers stepwise; persistent H1 features of the Lorenz attractor number 2 (the wings)
claims.scope: finite point cloud subsample of a long trajectory

claims.claim: d(eigenvalue)/d(gamma) diverges as sqrt(gamma - gamma_EP) near coalescence; encircling the exceptional point permutes eigen-sheets
d(fidelity)/d(chi) saturates to 1 once bond dimension chi covers the Schmidt rank; entanglement entropy bounds compression

claims.claim: d(energy_error)/dt is bounded for symplectic integrators and secularly growing for non-structure-preserving ones at equal step size
claims.scope: separable Hamiltonian systems, fixed dt; demonstrated on Kepler

d ln[P(+Sigma)/P(-Sigma)] / dSigma = 1/kB: entropy production obeys an exponential symmetry, not strict positivity, at the single-trajectory level
claims.scope: overdamped dragged harmonic trap, equilibrium initial ensemble; measured slope 0.95
